questions.question: You expect to wait 15 minutes for the next truck. What is the best action?
options: Keep the engine at high idle so you are ready
Shut the engine down, or let automatic shutdown do it
Travel around the site until the truck arrives
questions.explanation: Shutting down during long waits saves fuel and engine hours.

questions.question: Why should you mark a task as blocked while waiting for a truck?
options: It hides the time from the supervisor
Blocked time is not counted as excessive idling, so the record is fair
questions.explanation: Blocked time shows the wait was outside your control.

questions.question: Which habit reduces fuel use during travel?
options: Reducing engine speed and keeping routes short
Spinning the wheels to accelerate faster
Travelling with the bucket raised high
questions.explanation: Lower engine speed and shorter routes cut fuel burn without losing productive work.

questions.question: What swing angle is most efficient when loading trucks?
questions.explanation: A smaller swing angle shortens every cycle.
